notes.title: SoDES will become free on July 7th to celebrate our new game!
notes.content:
Why? Well, it’s an aging game that isn’t really “worth it” anymore. A couple years ago we reduced the price to 99 cents, but for an 8 year old game, we feel the right price is zero.

Also, every time we work on a new game, we like to make an old one free. The new game is Strange Seed:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2463690/Strange_Seed/

It’s a 3D creature evolution game — like Spore, except not, because it’s an RPG. We’d be happy if you checked it out and wishlisted it. Or… just play SoDES for free. Whatever you like!

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2040742305291677752/1D8C694A859888D4CF69CAE3DFFCC2387B4D2174/?imw=1024&imh=534&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=true[/img]

Thanks,
The Chronicle Games Team
